title: AI Agents, Custom Silicon, and Governance Elevate Cloud Landscape – November 2026 Consolidated Overview
core_insight: AI agents and custom silicon are jointly reshaping cloud platforms, driving deeper AI integration, governance enhancements, and highlighting emerging supply‑chain and regulatory risks.

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出本地模拟器和ECS Gateway提升本地开发，Google Cloud强化AI代理可观测性与治理，Azure持续发布AI Agent服务（Foundry Agent Service）和Copilot Harness，均为云原生工具的渐进升级。 AWS加码AI安全Continuum和GPT-6.1生成式AI服务，Google Cloud推出AI驱动的组织策略、SentinelOne自主防御及跨云互联，Azure发布针对EDA工作负载的Cobalt 200专用芯片并引入Cloud HSM硬件审计日志，体现AI与底层硬件深度融合。 Test your applications against AWS locally with AWS Emulator AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools, and more (November 2, 2026) New AI agent observability and governance across BigQuery and Looker Powering agentic cloud governance: What's new in Organization Policy Autonomous defense at cloud speed with SentinelOne and Google Security Operations Building the next generation of multimodal AI experiences with fal in Microsoft Foundry Designing Azure silicon on Azure silicon: EDA workloads on Cobalt 200 Azure Cloud HSM Hardware Audit Logging: Verifiable audit trails for security and compliance
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 今日未见AWS、Azure、阿里云等主要云厂商公布新的定价或区域扩张信息；Google Cloud通过Cross‑Cloud Interconnect扩展网络覆盖，Azure发布《数字主权》系列博客，暗示将提供多地区合规AI部署选项。 未出现新的GPU或绿色数据中心官方公告；Google Cloud聚焦HPC合作与AI算力需求，Azure展示Cobalt 200专用VM供应能力，Cloudflare推出Spend Management功能提升算力消费可控性。 Where supercomputing meets agentic AI: What’s new in Google Cloud HPC and AI at SC26 Simplifying last mile cloud connectivity with Lumen and partner Cross-Cloud Interconnect
